_arch_note: 48K-STEP QUANTISED ARM, for nebius (tasks e663fef2, c7fa57a3, dd867f3d): exp_g_abl_05 (LUT ablation row 3.2 +TV, seed 1) in EVERY respect except n_steps 16000 -> 48000 and lut_quant_mode='p2_int8' (the power-of-two int8 read with straight-through training). Its 16K twin on gpustar is exp_g_abl_48_..._p2int8_postmerge126. Code pinned at research/ffn_replacement_fix 4ad02234900413fa7555e4c4048de80fae4346f5 (dd8c271e = PR #126 merge, + 4ad02234 = the sm_90 allowlist gate; the gpustar 16K runs use dd8c271e, identical on a 5090). LR schedule: warmup (10% of n_steps = 4800) and the cosine decay horizon (to n_steps, floor 0.1 x lr) derive from n_steps, so both stretch to 48K. Implementation serving the quantised path (CUDA kernel on a validated architecture, else the torch definition) is decided by the validation gate and recorded by preflight / train.log. W&B: wandb.ai cloud, project Spiky, group lut_ablation, run = exp_name. Previous note: LUT ABLATION ROW 3.2 +TV (Table B's +TV column). Row 3.2's config (exp_g_0248 fork + lut_read_top_n 2, lut_read_tau 0.5, lut_read_tau_learnable true) + lut_cell_smoothness 10.0, the exp_g_0249 penalty. tau is a deliberate choice: 0.5 at initialisation, learnable per layer. lut_read_tau is tau itself (LightMultiHeadLUT stores log_tau = ln 0.5 and reads tau = exp(log_tau)); checked at build: every layer tau = 0.500000000. Trainer: exp_g_0249's train.py (exp_g_0248's trainer + the lut_cell_smoothness switch, off at 0 so the math is exp_g_0248's + read-only lut_tv columns + the optional non-fatal wandb tracker). Reference: exp_g_0249 1.163698 (3.1 +TV).
